evidence_frontier: The latest completed evidence shows that the w8 local width passed its 100‑epoch confirmation gate (444/500 vs 448/500) confirming its robustness. The earlier 100‑seed experiment (Exp021) reported w12 aggregate correct 884 vs w16 control 897, but without confirmation. Thus the frontier is a confirmed w8 and an unconfirmed w12 performance relative to w16.
analysis: Observation: w8 achieved aggregate Q.ANT correct within 4 of the w16 control over 500 predictions and passed the preregistered gate. w12 previously yielded 884 correct versus 897 for w16 on the same seed set, a 13‑point gap, but this was not a confirmed experiment. Hypothesis: Under a fresh, independent seed set, the intermediate local width w12 will achieve aggregate Q.ANT correct predictions within 10 of the w16 control, demonstrating comparable robustness to the confirmed w8 width.

proposal.title: 100‑epoch w12 Confirmation on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Does the intermediate local width of 12 maintain comparable Q.ANT classification performance to the w16 control under a fresh seed set?
proposal.rationale: w8 has been confirmed as robust, but widths between 8 and 16 have not been independently validated under the same confirmation protocol. Testing w12 with fresh seeds will assess whether performance degrades gradually with width reduction or if w12 behaves consistently, providing a robustness measurement for the local representation without claiming minimality.
proposal.success_criteria: alpha5_w12.aggregate_qant_correct >= alpha5_w16_control.aggregate_qant_correct - 10 (out of 500 predictions per model)
proposal.risks: w12 may underperform relative to the control and fail the gate, limiting conclusions about intermediate widths; the limited seed count (5) may not capture full variability; computational budget constraints could restrict additional repeats if results are borderline.
